contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F3 would leave no surviving signal and the policy would land on benign — the opposite of the human-review path we chose.

risk.rationale: Confirmed suspicious sign-ins for s.demir@aegean.edu from a Cloudvault VPS ASN outside account baseline (F1, T1078.004) together with confirmed CISA KEV exposure on the edge VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 (F3, T1133/T1190) indicate potential account takeover via external remote services. However, this is not a confirmed ATO chain: the link between the suspicious sign-ins and the VPN appliance cannot be confirmed because DQ vpn_session_order is failing for appliance:vpn-edge-01, F2 (DE sign-in concentration) is only LIKELY not confirmed, and no post-compromise activity (mailbox access, password/MFA changes, lateral movement) is verified. Per policy, exposure plus conflicting/insufficient evidence requires human review → escalate.
